case.case_title: Senadeera, Inspector of Police, Pulmuddai Police Station vs Lt. Siyasinghe and others
case.source_citation: Sri Lanka Law Reports (2005) 7 Sri L. R. 335

clause.text: No citizen shall be discriminated against on the grounds of race, religion, language, caste, sex, political opinion, place of birth or any one of such grounds.

case_context.legal_issue: Whether the petitioner was discriminated against by the respondents on prohibited grounds under Article 12(2).
case_context.petitioner_claim: The petitioner claimed discrimination by army personnel infringing his fundamental rights under Article 12(2).
case_context.respondent_argument: Respondents denied discrimination, emphasizing lack of evidence and contradictory accounts.
key_facts: Petitioner alleged assault and discriminatory treatment by army officers and soldiers.
No independent evidence supporting claims of discrimination.
Medical and legal proceedings did not substantiate petitioner’s allegations.
Court found petitioner’s claims unsubstantiated and exaggerated.

reasoning.interpretation_summary: Article 12(2) prohibits discrimination on specified grounds. The court requires clear evidence to prove discrimination. Mere allegations without credible support are insufficient.
reasoning.application_to_facts: The petitioner failed to provide independent or corroborative evidence of discrimination. The court found no proof that the petitioner was treated differently on any prohibited ground.
principles_established: Discrimination claims under Article 12(2) require credible and independent evidence.
Unsubstantiated allegations do not meet the burden of proof.
Legal and medical findings are relevant to assessing discrimination claims.

outcome.holding: The court held that the petitioner failed to prove discrimination under Article 12(2).

link_explanation.why_this_clause_matters: Article 12(2) was directly invoked by the petitioner alleging discrimination, but the court’s dismissal was based on failure to prove such discrimination with credible evidence.

evidence.evidence_excerpt: The petitioner’s allegations of discrimination were unsupported by independent affidavits or corroborative evidence, and the court found no material to substantiate the claim.
